lead: Footwear a person owns, organised by family (sneakers, sports and outdoor shoes, dress shoes, heels and flats, boots, sandals, traditional footwear, slippers, care), then kind, then named archetype and version.

depts.note: Organised by lineage → silhouette → cut (High/Mid/Low) and release (OG/retro) → colourway by style code, the StockX/GOAT/KicksDB axis.

b.w: Collectors identify a pair by silhouette, release and style code first (StockX/GOAT/KicksDB).
Resale buying turns on a verified genuine pair.
Condition sets resale value.
Limited releases rank above general releases for collectors.

s.brief: Archetype standard: kind → silhouette (archetype, with originator and year) → versions (OG, retro, notable collaborations) → detail (High/Mid/Low cut, material, colourway by style code). Basketball: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star (and Chuck 70), Air Jordan 1, Nike Air Force 1, Nike Dunk, Nike Blazer, adidas Superstar, Reebok BB 4600/Pump, later Jordans (III, IV, XI) as versions or separate archetypes. Court: adidas Stan Smith, Lacoste (Carnaby), Reebok Club C, K-Swiss Classic, Puma Smash, Nike Killshot, Diadora B. Elite. Canvas: Superga 2750, Keds Champion, Vans Authentic, Converse Jack Purcell, PF Flyers, Spring Court, Dunlop Green Flash. Drop retail SKU noise (VL Court 3.0, Court Advance) unless they fit an archetype; Ozweego goes to Chunky, Palermo to Terrace (other shelf). Use t: High, Mid, Low.

k.brief: High-top kind dissolved: cut becomes a type; holds Chuck Taylor, AJ1, AF1, Dunk, Blazer, Superstar.
Former 'Low-top sneaker' (attribute-only); tennis/court lineage: Stan Smith, Club C, Lacoste, K-Swiss.
Plimsoll lineage: Superga 2750, Keds Champion, Vans Authentic, Jack Purcell, Green Flash.

s.brief: Heritage runners: Nike Cortez, Nike Air Max 1/90/95/97 (Air Max family), New Balance 990 series (990v1–v6) and 574/550-type icons, ASICS Gel-Lyte III, Onitsuka Tiger Mexico 66, adidas ZX series, Saucony Jazz, Nike Waffle. Terrace: adidas Gazelle, Samba, Spezial, Handball, Campus, SL72; Puma Suede, Palermo; Diadora. Chunky: Fila Disruptor, adidas Ozweego, Nike P-6000-type, Balenciaga Triple S as the designer originator (cross-reference designer kind). Same archetype standard; versions by generation and OG/retro.

k.brief: Air Max, NB 990, Cortez, Gel-Lyte III, ZX.
Gazelle, Samba, Spezial, Campus, Puma Suede/Palermo.
Dad shoe; keep Triple S, Disruptor, Ozweego; drop Puma Defy and Nike Axis unless sourced as icons.

s.brief: Skate: Vans Old Skool, Sk8-Hi, Era, Authentic (cross-ref), Classic Slip-On; Nike SB Dunk; éS Accel; Emerica Reynolds; DC, Etnies, Osiris D3, Supra Skytop, adidas Busenitz. Slip-on: Vans Classic Slip-On as originator. Designer/luxury: Common Projects Achilles Low, Balenciaga Triple S/Speed, Golden Goose Super-Star, Rick Owens Geobasket, Maison Margiela Replica (GAT lineage), Alexander McQueen oversized, Louis Vuitton Trainer, Dior B23, Gucci Ace. Brand facts into the register.

k.brief: Luxury and minimalist designer sneakers; Achilles, Triple S, Super-Star, Geobasket, Replica.

depts.note: Tier for walking and water shoes; variety at the running and hiking enthusiast end.

b.v: about a thumb's width at the toe
b.w: Checked first for running, walking and hiking footwear.
Cushioning is chosen for the distance run; a matter of choice.
Support is matched to the runner's gait; a choice, not a ranking.
Heel-to-toe drop and stack height are compared last.
Worn-out cushioning ends a running shoe's useful life.

s.brief: Running shoes as model-family archetypes with generations: Nike Pegasus, Brooks Ghost/Adrenaline GTS, Hoka Clifton/Bondi, ASICS Gel-Kayano/Gel-Nimbus, New Balance 1080/880, Saucony Kinvara/Ride, adidas Ultraboost/Adizero, carbon-plate racers (Nike Vaporfly/Alphafly) as an archetype. Trail: Salomon Speedcross, Brooks Cascadia, Hoka Speedgoat, Saucony Peregrine, La Sportiva Bushido, VJ. Minimalist: Vibram FiveFingers, Xero, Vivobarefoot, Merrell Vapor Glove, Altra (zero-drop). Walking: kind-level with test winners (Which?/Consumer Reports) only. Trim Hoka list to its families.

Hiking shoe and hiking boot by archetype: Merrell Moab (originator of the mass hiking shoe), Salomon X Ultra / Quest, Lowa Renegade, Scarpa, Meindl, Hanwag, Zamberlan, Keen Targhee; heritage leather hikers (Danner Mountain Light) only if sourced. Classify boots by cut (low, mid, high) and weight (light, backpacking, mountaineering) as types; drop Paraboot Avoriaz from hiking unless sourced. Water shoes: tier, 3–5 makers (Astral, Keen, Speedo).

depts.note: Kind → archetype (cap-toe, wholecut, brogue, Adelaide, penny loafer…) → maker's model → leather and last.

b.v: hand-welted > Goodyear welted > Blake or Blake Rapid > cemented
b.w: Comes first for shoes: it decides whether the shoe can be resoled, how long it lasts and how comfortable it is on day one.

b.v: full-grain calf, shell cordovan > corrected grain
b.w: Weighed after construction.
The last sets fit and look; follows the leather. A matter of choice, not a ranking.

b.v: the maker's hand-grade line > its main line (for example Hand Grade)
b.w: Grade lines within one maker show the finishing; compare them only within that maker.
Price set against the points above, weighed last.

s.brief: Archetypes under Oxford: plain-toe, cap-toe, wholecut, Adelaide, full brogue (wingtip), semi-brogue, quarter brogue, balmoral. Under Derby: plain, apron/split-toe, longwing blucher (Alden), Norwegian/split-toe, gillie. Monk: single, double (and triple). Saddle: Spalding-type two-tone. Reference models as versions: Edward Green Chelsea/Dover, Crockett & Jones Hallam/Westfield, Alden 990 longwing and Indy, John Lobb City II/Philip II, Carmina, Church's Consul/Shannon/Diplomat, Tricker's Bourton, Paraboot Michael/Chambord, Berluti Alessandro, Allen Edmonds Park Avenue. Construction (hand-welted, Goodyear, Blake, Norwegian) is a detail axis, not a kind. Drop DapperFam, Giovanni, Belvedere and Giorgio Venturi retail SKUs; cap per-kind models to market-covering makers. Brand register: Edward Green, Crockett & Jones, Alden, Carmina, John Lobb, Church's, Tricker's, Cheaney, Loake, Gaziano & Girling, Allen Edmonds, Paraboot, Berluti, Meermin, Vass, Saint Crispin's.

Loafer archetypes: penny loafer (G.H. Bass Weejun 1936 originator; Alden 986, Church's, Edward Green Piccadilly, J.M. Weston 180), tassel loafer (Alden 563), horsebit loafer (Gucci 1953), Belgian loafer (Belgian Shoes), Venetian/plain vamp, kiltie. Moccasin: driving moc (Tod's Gommino, Car Shoe), camp moc, Clarks Wallabee, Minnetonka, Quoddy, Rancourt. Boat shoe: Sperry Authentic Original (1935, originator), Sebago Docksides, Timberland 3-Eye. Evening slipper: Prince Albert slipper (velvet, embroidered; Bowhill & Elliott, Stubbs & Wootton, Del Toro) and opera pump; the old 'plain slip-on' catch-all is dissolved — TOMS Alpargata goes to espadrille.

k.brief: Replaces the 'Plain slip-on shoe' catch-all; fixes the Prince Albert slipper misfile; opera pump as archetype.

depts.note: Tier mainstream; variety at the luxury end (named designer archetypes).

b.v: flat; kitten (3–5 cm); mid; high (8 cm+)
b.w: Heel height and pitch decide wearability; a choice, not a ranking.
Lining and sole decide comfort and repairability.
At the luxury end pairs are known by the house's named model.

s.brief: Luxury archetypes with house, year and versions (heel heights, materials): Christian Louboutin So Kate, Pigalle (red sole); Manolo Blahnik Hangisi, BB; Jimmy Choo Romy; Chanel two-tone slingback (1957) and ballerina; Salvatore Ferragamo Vara; Roger Vivier Belle Vivier (buckle pump); Repetto Cendrillon (ballet flat originator, 1956); Mary Jane: Start-rite, Repetto, Prada; T-bar shoe as a type of Mary Jane (fix the 'T-bar sandal' misfile). Drop high-street SKUs (Betts, Wittner) unless test winners. Types: kitten heel, stiletto, block heel on court shoe.

Mule archetypes: Gucci Princetown (horsebit backless loafer), Birkenstock-style cork mules handled under clog/sandal; drop retail SKUs (Lucky Brand, Mia, Vionic). Clog: Swedish clog (Troentorp, Sven), Dansko Professional, Birkenstock Boston, Crocs Classic Clog (cross-check it belongs here), Dutch klomp handled in Traditional footwear. Espadrille: Castañer (and the Yves Saint Laurent wedge, 1970s), Soludos, TOMS Alpargata (moved in from the dissolved slip-on kind); Spanish/Basque tradition entry if sourced.

depts.note: Ankle boot is a grouping (shelf), not a kind; heritage boots by archetype (service, engineer, logger, moc-toe, jodhpur, 1460).

b.v: hand-welted > Goodyear welted / stitch-down > Blake > cemented
b.w: Comes first for boots: it decides whether the boot can be resoled, how long it lasts and how comfortable it is on day one.

b.v: full-grain, Horween Chromexcel, shell cordovan > corrected grain
b.w: Weighed after construction.
The last sets fit and look. A matter of choice, not a ranking.
Price set against the points above, weighed last.

s.brief: Chelsea: J. Sparkes-Hall origin, Blundstone 500/550, R.M. Williams Comfort Craftsman, Dr. Martens 2976; trim the 17-model list to market-covering makers and icons. Chukka/desert boot: Clarks Desert Boot (1950, originator), Sanders, Red Wing Weekender Chukka. Jodhpur boot (new): strap-and-buckle ankle boot; Crockett & Jones, John Lobb, Saint Laurent versions. Bootie: the old generic 'Ankle boot' becomes the heeled fashion ankle boot (zip, lace or pull-on).

k.brief: Heeled fashion ankle boot; 'ankle boot' itself is now the shelf grouping.

s.brief: Archetype standard for the heritage-boot community (makers in register: Red Wing, Alden, White's, Viberg, Wesco, Nicks, Danner, Thorogood, Chippewa, Wolverine, John Lofgren, Grant Stone, Truman). Service boot: Red Wing Iron Ranger and Beckman, Viberg Service Boot, Alden Indy, Wolverine 1000 Mile, Grant Stone Diesel. Moc-toe (new): Red Wing Classic Moc 875 (1952), Thorogood, Russell. Logger (new): White's Smoke Jumper, Wesco Jobmaster, Nicks, Red Wing Logger. Engineer: Red Wing 2268, Wesco Boss. Combat/military: Dr. Martens 1460 (1960, eight-eye), US jungle boot, Corcoran jump boot, M-43 service shoe, Danner. Work boot keeps general lace-up work boots (Timberland 6-inch Premium as archetype). Split-toe: jika-tabi (Marugo).

k.brief: Include Dr. Martens 1460 as an archetype.

s.brief: Cowboy boot archetypes: classic western, roper, buckaroo, packer; makers Lucchese, Tony Lama, Justin, Ariat, Rios of Mercedes, Tecovas, Old Gringo; tradition entry for Texas boot-making if sourced. Knee-high absorbs the riding-style boot (Sam Edelman Penny); designer archetypes (Stuart Weitzman 5050 and Lowland). Over-the-knee: Stuart Weitzman Highland. Equestrian riding boot: field vs dress boot types; Ariat, Cavallo, Konig, Parlanti, Fabbri, Dehner, Tredstep. Drop high-street SKUs.

k.brief: Riding-style boot merged in as a type.

s.brief: Rain boot: Hunter Original Tall, Le Chameau, Aigle, Wellington (Hessian origin), Blundstone; Bogs. Duck boot (new): L.L.Bean Bean Boot (1912 Maine Hunting Shoe, originator), Sorel Caribou-adjacent. Snow boot: Sorel Caribou, Baffin, Kamik, Moon Boot (1969). Sheepskin: UGG Classic Short/Tall, EMU, Australian sheepskin makers; mukluk and valenki go to Traditional footwear.

depts.note: Tier for everyday sandals; variety for icons (Birkenstock Arizona, Teva Original, Havaianas).

b.v: contoured cork or moulded footbed > flat
b.w: Decides comfort for all-day wear.
Adjustable straps decide fit for sports and walking sandals.

s.brief: Icons as archetypes: Havaianas Top/Brasil (1962), Birkenstock Arizona (1973), Madrid, Gizeh, Boston (clog); adidas Adilette (1972, slide originator), Teva Original Universal (1984), Chaco Z/1, Keen Newport, fisherman sandal, jelly sandal, Ho Chi Minh sandal, Roman/Grecian sandal (gladiator), Mexican huarache, Ancient Greek Sandals, Hermès Oran. Wedge absorbs the Wörishofer (misfile fix) and cork wedges; heeled sandal absorbs the 'Other heeled sandals' catch-all (types: block, stiletto, kitten). Kolhapuri and Peshawari chappals go to Traditional footwear. Trim Teva/Chaco/Keen/Havaianas SKU lists to families.

depts.note: Organised by craft tradition; each kind links to a tradition-register entry.

b.v: hand-made in the source region > factory imitation
b.w: Tradition-register authenticity markers (GI status, materials, technique).

s.brief: Kind → regional archetype, with tradition entries (region, technique, materials, centres, GI/authenticity): Geta (koma-geta, takageta, tengu-geta, okobo) and Zōri/setta (Japan); Jika-tabi cross-ref; Kolhapuri chappal (GI, Maharashtra/Karnataka) and Peshawari chappal (moved from flat strap sandal); Jutti/mojari (Punjab, Rajasthan); Paduka; Babouche (Morocco; from the slippers list 'Baboosh'); Dutch klomp (wooden clog); Valenki (Russian felt boot); Mukluk / Inuit kamik; Opanak (Balkans). Keep to ≤12 kinds.

Restraint: one kind with types closed, backless (scuff), slipper boot, moccasin slipper; keep 5–8 market-covering makers (Acorn, L.L.Bean, UGG, Minnetonka, Dearfoams, Isotoner); move 'Baboosh' out (babouche is in Traditional footwear).

depts.note: All shoe care lives here (polish moves in from B6); tier for accessories, variety for the shoe-shine hobby (Saphir, Kiwi, Collonil, Tarrago, Boot Black).

b.w: Smooth calf, suede/nubuck, shell cordovan and exotic leathers each need their own products.

s.brief: Shoe polish: wax polish vs cream polish vs conditioner vs waterproofing spray as types; brands Saphir Médaille d'Or (Pâte de Luxe, Renovateur), Kiwi, Collonil, Tarrago, Boot Black, Famaco, Lincoln, Venetian Shoe Cream. Shoe cleaner: suede/sneaker cleaners (Jason Markk, Crep Protect, Reshoevn8r). Shoe brush (new): horsehair, dauber, suede brush. Shoe-shine kit (new). Shoe tree: cedar (split-toe, full-toe), lasted trees (C&J, Edward Green, Saphir, Woodlore). Shoe horn: horn, metal, long-handled (Abbeyhorn).
Restraint: kind-level entries with 2–4 makers each; drop the Tingley trade overshoe model (keep galosh types); spats keep cloth/leather types.
